limitations: Self-selected app-store reviews; not representative of all users.

Exact-text reuse labels 159552 [K05] records, so duplicates share one label.
Cancellation language is expressed intent, not observed churn. No revenue or causal estimates are made.

memo.recommendation: Under the baseline rule (priority_score = complaint_count x mean_severity), the generic "other" bucket ranks first at 78701 [C04] but is not a product area. Among specific areas, the top issue is free tier limits and paywalled features, with a priority score of 18916 [C08] from 6975 complaints [C05]. I recommend billing/support, with usability (ads, 16481 [C12]) as the close alternative. This is self-selected historical review evidence and expresses intent, not churn.

supporting_evidence.point: Billing_support has the highest area severity_sum among specific areas after usability's 30785 [T09]; it is 23467 [T15], with the highest cancellation count of any area at 1924 [T14]. Its leading issue (free-tier restrictions) is the top specific issue at 18916 [C06].
Mean severity for the free-tier issue is 2.711971 [C07], above ads at 2.040991 [C11].
